claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG logo and "Inverter DirectDrive 7kg" text on the control panel; the witness identifies it as a front load washing machine.
Neither the photos nor the witness report show the seller's location.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or complete a wash cycle.
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine powering on, filling, agitating, spinning, and draining.
risks.if_unproven: as not working, for parts or repair

risks.risk: Age is unknown and may be near end of life.
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacturer's label with serial number or original purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: as unknown age, worst-case older unit

risks.risk: Undisclosed repairs or heavy previous usage.
risks.proof: Service records or photos of the rear panel, hoses, and internal drum showing no repair marks.
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used or previously repaired

risks.risk: Water inlet and drain hoses are not included.
risks.proof: Photo showing the hoses present with the machine.

risks.risk: Visible rust stains indicate deeper corrosion or leaks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted lower panel and underside, plus a dry-run leak check.
risks.if_unproven: as cosmetically and structurally compromised by rust

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and running a full cycle.
Photo of the manufacturer's label or serial number.
Photo showing inlet and drain hoses included.
Close-up photos of the rusted areas and underside.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load washing machine with visible rust; since function and age are unproven, it is priced at worst case as non-working, with proof listed that would raise the value.
